data.description: The Chest Press is the single-user version of our outdoor pressing machine: one orange seat, a backrest and two handles at chest height. The user sits, pushes the handles away and controls them on the way back, using body weight as the resistance. It is a simple first strength machine for a small society gym or a school campus. It pairs well with a leg machine so users can train upper and lower body in one visit. The Chest Press comes in Play Orange; we share its size and warranty terms with the quote. For the Chest Press, we will confirm cover in the quote; our usual terms are 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings. Ask us where it fits on your plan.

items.pText: The Chest Press is the single-user version of our outdoor pressing machine: one orange seat, a backrest and two handles at chest height. The user sits, pushes the handles away and controls them on the way back, using body weight as the resistance. It is a simple first strength machine for a small society gym or a school campus. It pairs well with a leg machine so users can train upper and lower body in one visit. The Chest Press comes in Play Orange; we share its size and warranty terms with the quote. For the Chest Press, we will confirm cover in the quote; our usual terms are 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings. Ask us where it fits on your plan.

A single-station machine like this can usually be installed self-standing on a firm base, or grouted if the soil is soft. The pivots under the handles are the parts that wear, so check them and the seat bolts during maintenance. Keep a clear zone in front of the handles.
